audiveris.about: Audiveris 5.11.0-sma.1 output cached by spike/omr/bench/run.py (install signature + tag prod2); the release both refs of round 2 read PDFs with

items.title: Voice-leading marks: short codes next to their own marks
items.look_at: Teacher codes, no leader lines, each code beside its own ring, one callout per chord. BWV 102.7 bar 2 is the busiest. The last picture is the unresolved tendency-tone arrow with R (decision S).

pictures.caption: BWV 64.4, bar 7: the unresolved tendency-tone arrow

items.title: Overlap rings on the right notes
items.look_at: BWV 418 callout 2, bars 4-5. The whole chorale, so bars 1 and 4-5 of item 1 are here too. The card shows page 1; page 2 is drawn by the same call.

items.title: "Check my analysis" page: note numbers in outlined circles
items.look_at: The numbers under the chord labels and before each note below the music.
items.notes: No tool draws this page yet, so it is drawn by the engine's render(student_labels=...). The student's numerals are the test answers in tests/data/check_display/ (written to show every kind of mark); there is no real student answer in the repo.

items.title: Corrected bar 18
items.look_at: Chopin Prelude Op. 28 No. 4, read from the MuseScore PDF, with bar 18 corrected to what the print has (its lost triplet). Only the changed bar is redrawn, shaded.

items.title: The result card: just the page and its buttons
items.look_at: The card as the chat shows it, 700 px wide: an analysis card (with More downloads) and a PDF-reading card (no extra downloads).

pictures.caption: Analysis card: Chopin Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2, bars 1-8
PDF-reading card: Chopin Prelude Op. 28 No. 4 (MuseScore PDF)

items.title: Piano view of Mozart's string quartet K.458
items.look_at: Bars 0-8 as a two-staff piano reduction, with the hand-checked analysis.

items.title: Cadential six-four drawn as V⁶₄ → ⁵₃ (decision A)
items.notes: None of the hand-checked analyses in examples/ labels a cadential six-four yet: the only candidate, Brahms Op. 118 No. 2 bar 4, reads I⁶₄ and your answer to question AJ (I⁶₄ or Cad⁶₄ there) is still pending. Earlier samples came from a stress-test label list, so no picture is shown until a real analysis has one.

items.title: PDF preview: what we read from your PDF
items.look_at: Read through the real PDF path, with its clean-up (decisions K, L, M, N). Chopin: phantom ending, restated key and double-sharp ring. K.545: bar numbers and shaded bars. Joplin: the real first and second endings. Schubert: key changes.
